name: Talking Head Production
headline: Talking Head Production: AI Avatar Video Generator
short_description: This skill allows users to create talking head videos using AI avatars with lipsync capabilities. It is designed for content creators and marketers looking to enhance video production with AI-generated voices and avatars.
author: inference-skills

sections.overview:
This skill generates talking head videos powered by AI avatars with integrated lipsync technology. It leverages inference.sh's video generation models to produce realistic avatars that speak with synchronized lip movements. The tool is built for content creators, marketers, and video producers who need to generate professional talking head content without requiring actors or complex filming setups. It integrates with 40+ video models available through the inference.sh platform, enabling flexible video production workflows.
Create promotional videos with AI avatars
Generate product tours using synthesized voices
Produce educational content with virtual presenters
